body:
1. Bump @adlc/cli from 1.6.0 to 1.11.1 in .github/workflows/publish.yml line 89 matching ci.yml and package.json.
2. In .github/workflows/ci.yml lines 40 & 76 and publish.yml line 52, fail closed on Linux runners if bwrap userns verification fails rather than echoing and continuing.
3. Enhance scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs to parse AST or detect CallExpression (import/require) so dynamic or template specifiers cannot hide non-builtin externals.

Verification: npm test && node scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs
title: Bump @adlc/cli pin in publish.yml, fail-closed bwrap userns check, and enhance bundle externals scanner
